resources.string: Choose a child to share their activities as an .ics calendar file, or import a file shared with you.

Choose an existing child or create a new one. Activities are added without removing anything. Exact duplicates are skipped. Weekly events keep repeating; dated events stay on their dates. Imported reminders use this device’s timing settings.
Supports timed events and weekly schedules. All-day, overnight, monthly and fortnightly events are not supported. Recurring events must use local time or this device’s time zone.
Shares only this saved activity, including its weekly repeats and date changes. Save any edits before sharing.
